honestFailureControl.change: Change observed byte evidence, recompute its actual fail verdict and set qualified:false consistently.
honestFailureControl.expected: Checker may accept this as internally consistent unqualified evidence. It must never become a successful qualification.
honestFailureControl.reason: Saved-report checking establishes consistency with fixed expectations, not report origin or cryptographic attestation. Do not mislabel every edited but honestly failed report as invalid.

qualificationRequirement: A full transfer claim needs qualified server and client scopes plus separately evidenced actual producer/authenticated transport/browser/Proton saved bytes.
